# Fidelis Care

> > Fidelis Care is a New York-based health insurance provider offering Medicaid, Medicare, Essential Plan, and other managed care programs through member and provider portals.

Fidelis Care, a Centene Corporation subsidiary, provides comprehensive health insurance solutions including Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare (Wellcare), Essential Plan, Child Health Plus, HARP, and MLTC programs. The site serves as the primary digital gateway for members to manage benefits and for healthcare providers to access administrative tools.

## Key Topics

- Medicaid Managed Care
- Medicare (Wellcare)
- Essential Plan
- Child Health Plus
- Provider Access Online
- HealthierLife rewards program
- HARP (Health and Recovery Plan)
- MLTC (Managed Long Term Care)
- Ambetter from Fidelis Care
- Fidelis Care at Home
- Wellcare Spendables
- My Wellcare Rewards
- Claims management
- Member portal services

## Main Portal Access

- [Home](https://www.fideliscare.org/): Fidelis Care homepage featuring Medicaid, Medicare, and Essential Plan options
- [Provider Access Online Login](https://providers.fideliscare.org/): Provider Access Online portal login for Fidelis Care healthcare providers
- [New Member Registration](https://members.fideliscare.org/en-us/Registration?returnurl=/en-us/Registration/returnurl/227): Member account creation and registration portal for Fidelis Care members

## Account Management

- [Member Account Validation](https://members.fideliscare.org/AccountValidation?result=registration-success&doredirect=true): Member account registration success confirmation page
